English says 'diminished in livelihood' (locative-type relation); Hindi 'से' gives another relation. Align with the English.

summary: Reviewed 22 units fresh against the Sanskrit. Issues: {'error': 6, 'minor': 13}; 18 machine patches. Main errors: unit 1 Hindi drops the ca joining the two agent lists; unit 3 Hindi adds तुम and misplaces the object of pratyādiś; unit 15 vaidehaka-antevāsin read as karmadhāraya (pupils who are traders) not 'pupils of the trader'. Minor: karma 'deeds'->'actions' (17), प्रतिविधान->प्रबन्ध (6), कार्य added (21), akāraṇa-kruddha label (21), आश्रय (22), साहसी (2), सिर (13), से/में (9, 11). Unit 18 gūḍha/sattrin: glossary allows no Hindi distinction, English brackets kept. text_flags units 1 and 4 are sound (tīṣkṇa -> tīkṣṇa; stray space in pravrajyā pratyavasitaḥ, same handling as 1.7 and 1.5). No regrouping suggested. No hand edits needed (no word or flag to add or delete).
